Gram-negative organisms are captured as **Meas Value** (culture results) and **Observation** concepts. Let me build the full analysis in one query using CTEs: identify gram-negative UTI index events, attach the initial antibiotic, classify carbapenem vs narrow-spectrum, and measure 60-day recurrence.

Let me define the gram-negative organism set broadly (Enterobacterales + Pseudomonas etc.) and run the cohort construction.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH gramneg_vals AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE (domain_id='Meas Value' OR domain_id='Observation') AND standard_concept='S'
    AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%escherichia coli%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%klebsiella%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%proteus%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pseudomonas%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%enterobacter%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%citrobacter%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%serratia%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%morganella%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%gram-negative%'
      OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%gram negative%')
),
uti_events AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS uti_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id=81902)
),
gn_meas AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_date AS gn_date
  FROM omop.measurement m
  WHERE m.value_as_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM gramneg_vals)
),
gn_obs AS (
  SELECT o.person_id, o.observation_date AS gn_date
  FROM omop.observation o
  WHERE o.observation_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM gramneg_vals)
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gn_meas) AS gn_measurements,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gn_obs) AS gn_observations,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.person_id) FROM uti_events u
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gn_meas g WHERE g.person_id=u.person_id
                   AND ABS(DATEDIFF(day, g.gn_date, u.uti_date))<=7)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gn_obs g WHERE g.person_id=u.person_id
                   AND ABS(DATEDIFF(day, g.gn_date, u.uti_date))<=7)
 ) AS gramneg_uti_patients;
